description.value: Garibaldi Lift Co. is Whistler's iconic après venue, perched slopeside in the Upper Village with a sunset deck and panoramic mountain views. It operates year-round and draws a strong mountain-bike and ski crowd with craft bites, cocktails, and a rotating roster of live DJs. The globally-inspired menu spans shareables, burgers, tacos, and poke bowls, with multiple vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options throughout.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 50m; rack at 53m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is complete and well-structured across four subpages. Address (4165 Springs Ln, Whistler), phone ((604) 905 2220), and email were confirmed via the /info subpage, all absent from the OSM record. The menu page explicitly labels multiple items V (vegetarian), VG (vegan), and GW (gluten-free), confirming dietary options. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; the menu item 'Bike Park Bhajis' is a food name, not evidence of bike facilities. The OSM name 'Garibaldi Lift Company' differs slightly from the website's consistent usage of 'Garibaldi Lift Co.'
concerns: OSM name is 'Garibaldi Lift Company' but website consistently uses 'Garibaldi Lift Co.' — minor name discrepancy.
